name: cjm-substrate-qt-kit
summary: The ONE Qt foundation library for the cjm-substrate application lane (ruling 8b7351e4): the design-system runtime (tokens from cjm-design-system resolved by ONE Theme into fonts, QPalette, QSS and Lucide icons with ONE change signal), the app shell (window frame, modal frame, keymap menus, job seat, launch resolution, session-key adoption) and the chrome every app shares. Requires ffmpeg on PATH for span playback. Born on-graph.
